data.body: **P2:** This continuation is invisible to `ExecutionManager.close()`: its activity lease prevents suspension, but normal handler completion does not wait for `checkpointRequestsInFlight`, and teardown only joins currently published user-handler futures. If an early-completed map/parallel branch or abandoned `waitForConditionAsync` queues READY work before the handler succeeds, teardown can close the checkpoint manager before this task starts; it can then execute another predicate with user side effects and attempt checkpoints after the invocation was finalized. Track admitted continuations, mark the manager as closing, recheck that state before running them, and wait for admitted tasks to release their leases during `close()`; add a held-coordinator test where the parent completes before dispatch.
